messages.subject: issue with terms - sleeping, running, idle ...
parts: Hi, landed on this great platform and I love already. I have some issue in understanding the 25 active H  of free plan. Active is defined as "not idle", but what is "not idle"? A running app without clients pushing requests is considered "idle"? Or "idle" is meaning sleeping? Thanks

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] issue with terms - sleeping, running, idle ...
parts:
Hi Davide,
Thanks for the kind words.  An application on shinyapps.io will be brought online when it gets its first request.  It will stay up and active until the last connection drops out, and the idle timeout is reached at which point it will put itself to sleep.    "Idle" means an application is up, but isn't being interacted with from any clients, there is a default timeout of 15 minutes built into the platform which will put the application to sleep, you can override that if you want and bring that down to 5 minutes. The active hours is literally the sum of minutes that the application was up for the month.

Hope this helps, and best of luck exploring the platform.

-Tareef
